form: T(n) = alpha_us + beta_us_per_elem * n, per op key and device configuration; pipelined GPU configs (-pipe): T(n) = max(alpha_us, b n) + k min(alpha_us, b n) with b = large_n.beta_us_per_elem and k = overlap.k (k = 1: the line alpha_us + b n); register_agg: the GPU's cost per register-accumulator update (its own form)

conventions.time: microseconds per morsel; cache-cold input (64 MB flush before every timed rep)
conventions.cpu-p, cpu-e: one worker thread on a P-core / E-core
conventions.gpu-warm: sync round trip (encode, commit, wait) on a GPU-resident buffer, GPU idle before
conventions.gpu-cold: as gpu-warm on fresh host memory wrapped no-copy right before; includes the wrap
conventions.-pipe: pipelined dispatch: GPU time per morsel with the queue kept full (span / K)
conventions.-priv: blit into a private buffer, then the kernel (resident: no blit); not a routing option
conventions.-spin: GPU kept busy (ALU-only kernel, ~20 ms) before each timed rep: the clock regime of a busy router
conventions.join, sort: groups = build rows after the filter (join) or radix passes / merged runs (sort)
conventions.contention: devices streaming together share B_max; each gets B_max * w_d * D_d / sum(w * D) of it when their solo demands D_d exceed it (w = 1 for CPU, w_gpu for GPU)
conventions.cache_states: ops are cache-cold; cache_states gives, per base config and state of the input (what last touched the rows), tables over the morsel's footprint that a predictor applies to the cold prediction (analysis/validate.py StatePred: delta | ratio | line)

register_agg.form: beta_U = max(l_C, U c) + kappa_C min(l_C, U c) per column count C; l_C = load_us_per_row (4C B at filter_count's rate); c from the fewest columns (c_from_cols), fitted with its kappa; kappa 0: loads and updates overlap completely, 1: they add. both_sides: measured on both sides of the crossover U = l_C / c (else c and kappa_C are not separable)

cache_states.form: per op key, base device config and state of the input (what last touched the rows), against the cold rows of the same runs: tables over the morsel's footprint F = bytes_per_row x n (per morsel; pipelined states measured at `batch` morsels per batch) of ratio (sync GPU: kernel time state / cold, ratio_of kernel; pipelined GPU and CPU: morsel time, ratio_of morsel), delta_us, delta_fixed_us (sync GPU: the round trip outside the kernel) and morsel_ratio (kernel_ratio too on the GPU); the state's own calibration (entry; line and cold_line: the slopes the predictors take) and the in-sample error of the predictor forms (form_err; analysis/validate.py StatePred). A predictor applies a state to the cold prediction of the base config: delta (+ delta_us(F); the default, the form that transferred to the held-out queries), ratio (streaming term x ratio(F), fixed part + delta_fixed_us(F)) or line, interpolated in log F and clamped
